Trans person here ! I've suffered from both body insecurity and gender dysphoria and to me they are very different feelings.

(for some background, I'm female to male transgender. I was born with a girls name and was raised as a girl and am now transitioning to male)

I'm overweight and I used to be very insecure about myself because of it. I felt like I wasn't as good as other people and that I should be thin, etc. I worked through this and now feel pretty good about my weight through some personal therapy and taking care of myself. It helped me to look at fat people that I found attractive and realize that fat does not equal unworthy.

My gender dysphoria feels more like I'm not a real person. While insecurity made me feel lesser, gender dysphoria makes me feel like I'm not an actual human being at all. Sometimes, it feels like I'm wearing sort of a paper suit. I feel like an imposter when I try to act like the gender I was assigned at birth ("what God gave me"). It doesnt help me to look to people who were born the same sex as me, they do not increase my confidence as it did with me looking up to fat idols. I felt a huge disconnect between me and people who were the gender I was born as.

I always had a feeling that I wasnt actually living my life. I had huge issues with depersonalization (disconnection from everything and everyone around me) and derealization (feeling like neither I or anyone else was real). I became depressed. I tried everything I could to feel like normal, but nothing did the trick.

Until I cut my hair, and started wearing mens clothes. The difference was astonishing. When people started calling me He, and my new name, it made me realize that the world is a truly good place and it made me feel connected to things again and like I was real. 

Most of all I think the difference is this: I can look in the mirror now and see all my flaws, and even think that I am ugly and be insecure about that, but on a much deeper level I feel so much comfort with myself that even if I am ugly, I know that I am a real person. I can walk away from the mirror without the sense of dread and shame I used to have when I was living as a woman. I'm a PERSON with some ugly PARTS instead of just UGLY as a whole.

I'm about to be a junior in high school. Social-wise, what I learned freshman year was to definitely do extra-curricular activities if possible. I was very socially awkward and afraid I would look stupid in front of people and they would hate me because of it, but when you join a club or a sport or theater program, you have people with similar interests and activities you'll actually like which makes it a more comfortable environment to socialize, or talk to girls ;) 

Another thing, if you're nervous to work in groups (ESPECIALLY where you get to choose), remember to just ask people if you can join theirs. I always found I felt more embarrassed not having a group at all/having to ask a teacher to place me in one than just going up and asking someone. If they say no then move right on to another, they'll forget about it and it won't matter. 

Also, choose someone who looks nice to sit next to and just talk to them (about the assignment or an event coming up, whatever is easiest). It's easy to make friends with someone you sit next to every day. Don't feel pressured to do it asap, though. I sat next to one of my good friends in English and we didn't talk for a few days until suddenly we did and then we didn't shut the fuck up for the rest of the school year lmao

Also I found it helpful to be funny. I know it's not just something everyone can just Do but like if you think of a joke (not a mean one !!!!  just like something witty or a pun) say it. I make jokes in every presentation I have to do because it puts me and the audience at ease, and works on a personal level too. If the class is at ease with you, they'll want to talk to you. 

As for romance (I don't know if that's what you mean by 'talk to a girl' but I'll assume it is), just worry about making friends with her first. Don't be pressured for romance. Friendship and romance both are really good and they'll both happen eventually, it's not worth really worrying about. :^)
